L retains the lower planted foliage outlines in the darker rainy approach. Rain reduces shadow evidence, but no conspicuous hovering gap or new route/trainer obstruction is observed in L. M's rock-side foliage remains raised in comparison.

Targeted rock-side foliage is outside these frames. Distant creatures near the gateway differ in pose/composition; their small projected size prevents detailed body-join or companion-contact certification.

new_trainer_or_companion_clipping: No new gross trainer or companion clipping is established in L from the supplied pixels. Distant creature silhouettes are small and differ between samples; overlap alone does not establish geometric interpenetration. Detailed creature contact remains unassessed.
introduced_defects: No introduced literal placeholder, obvious floating prop, route blockage or gross trainer clipping is observed in L across the five supplied views.
broad_terrain_art_bar: Sparse broad grass and terrain layering remain separate release-art concerns; they are not used to block the literal contact improvement.
limits: Five fixed Low/Compatibility native1280x720 view pairs at one arrival location, including one rain approach. No continuous motion, collision, earned route, full biome, High/Medium, >=200-frame matrix, all foliage/body contact at other stands, full F40#5, full release visual bar or whole-catalogue claim.
